title: Runs: agents the senior launches appear on the canvas; clicking one opens its terminal on the right
brief:
Desktop app (React 19 + TS + Tailwind v4 + @xyflow/react 12 + lucide-react, folder desktop/). The simple Smurf shell lives in desktop/src/smurf/ (read theme.css, RunsView.tsx, runs/runApi.ts, canvas/FlowCanvas.tsx, canvas/NodeCard.tsx and canvas/graph.ts first; black theme; use the CSS variables and .sm-* classes; keep FlowCanvas's performance rules: module-level nodeTypes, apply all xyflow changes, rebuild only when inputs change identity).
Server API (serverJson from '../../services/serverUrl'): GET /api/runs/:runId/agents -> { agents: RunAgent[] } with RunAgent = { id: string; kind: 'senior'|'worker'|'review'; node: string /* workflow node TYPE, e.g. 'agent.delegate' */; task?: string; title: string; model: string; attempt?: number; status: string /* e.g. running, checked, accept, retry, reassign, escalate, 'accept (owner)', 'failed (rate_limit)', 'score 93', done */; startedAt: string; live: boolean }, oldest first. GET /api/runs/:runId/logs/:agentId?offset=N -> { text: string; offset: number; size: number; skipped?: number } = terminal output since byte N (ANSI already stripped; at most 64 KB; poll again with the returned offset; skipped > 0 means older output was dropped).
1. runs/runApi.ts: add the RunAgent type, `fetchAgents(runId)` (fallback []), `fetchLog(runId, agentId, offset)`, and a pure `agentTone(a: RunAgent): 'run'|'wait'|'ok'|'bad'|'muted'` (live or running/checked -> run; escalate -> wait; accept, 'accept (owner)', score >= 80 -> ok; failed*, reassign, retry, 'no review', score < 80 -> bad; else muted). Add tests for agentTone to runApi.test.ts (keep existing tests).
2. canvas/AgentNode.tsx: memo'ed custom node 'agent', 180x48, radius 8px, background var(--panel), 1px border in the tone color (var(--run)/var(--wait)/var(--ok)/var(--bad)/var(--line)), selected: 2px border var(--text). Content: lucide icon by kind (senior Brain, worker Bot, review ShieldCheck) + one line title (truncate) + below it the model in 10px .mono var(--muted) (truncate) and the status at the right in the tone color. A pulsing dot when live (respect reduced motion via the existing theme rule). Only a target Handle on top (no source handles).
3. canvas/FlowCanvas.tsx: add optional props `agents?: { id: string; anchor: string /* workflow node id */; data: Record<string, unknown> }[]`, `selectedAgentId?: string | null`, `onSelectAgent?: (id: string | null) => void`. Register 'agent' in the module-level nodeTypes. Agent nodes are extra read-only nodes (not part of the Graph, never passed to onChange/fromFlow, not draggable, not deletable): place them under their anchor node, stacked (anchor.x + 10, anchor.y + 110 + 64 * index-among-agents-of-that-anchor; when an anchor has more than 6 agents show the newest 6), each with a dashed edge (strokeDasharray '4 3', stroke var(--line), animated when data.live) from the anchor to the agent. Merge them into the node/edge state without touching graph nodes' positions; when only the agents list changes, update just the agent nodes/edges (setNodes/setEdges with a filter by id prefix 'agent:'; use node ids `agent:${id}`). Clicking an agent node calls onSelectAgent(id) instead of onSelect; clicking the pane calls both with null. Without the agents prop the canvas behaves exactly as now.
4. runs/AgentTerminal.tsx: props { runId, agent: RunAgent, live: boolean, onClose }. Right panel 420px wide, full height, background #050506, left border var(--line). Header: kind icon, title, model (.mono muted), status in its tone color, a Close (X) button. Body: the terminal: <pre> .mono 12px line-height 1.45, color #d4d4d8, white-space pre-wrap, word-break break-all, scrollable. Load with offset 0, then poll fetchLog every 1000 ms with the last offset while `live` or agent.live is true (stop otherwise, one final fetch). Append text; keep at most 400 KB (drop from the start). If skipped > 0 show a muted line '… earlier output skipped'. Auto-scroll to the bottom unless the user scrolled up (then show a small 'Jump to latest' button). Reset everything when agent.id changes. Empty log: muted 'No output yet'.
5. RunsView.tsx: for the selected run, poll fetchAgents every 2 s while the run is live (once more when it stops; also once on selection). Map agents to FlowCanvas `agents`: anchor = id of the first graph node whose type === agent.node (skip agents with no matching node). Track selectedAgentId; when set, render AgentTerminal on the right of the canvas area (canvas shrinks; keep the existing Messages/Log area below). Selecting another run clears it. Keep all existing behaviour.
